title: A virtual office on the DTR page
description: Everyone can switch the DTR table to a 3D office: one room per department, with everyone who is timed in right now sitting at their desk, typing. Team leaders and above can look into every room; everyone else sees the whole floor, but other departments' rooms are closed — only their own room, the all-hands room and the shared spaces are open.
items: Virtual office, beside Columns, swaps the table for the office under the year heat map; Back to table returns
Also on the dashboard, which is now two columns: announcements and then the office on the left, your punch, counts and what needs you on the right
Move around it like the Sims: drag to move to any corner; turn with right-drag, Shift-drag, the turn buttons or Q and E; scroll or pinch to zoom; and a button to reset
A lounge beside the rooms: reception with the VizServe logo and the team photo, a wall of our clients, a coffee bar, a canteen, pool, ping-pong, a sofa corner and a meeting table
A gym at the end of the lounge — treadmills, exercise bikes, a bench press and dumbbells
A breakout area after the gym: a co-working bar with laptops, foosball and an arcade machine, bean bags, a reading nook, and a row of massage chairs
An office cat that wanders the floor, looks into every room, and sits a while at the canteen and the gym

Each department has its own walled room, dressed on all four walls for its work: an animated ad screen for media, a code screen, server rack and turning gears for VizBytes, a climbing growth chart and binders for VizBooks, a calendar, to-do board and corkboard for VizAssists. The walls nearest the camera drop down so you can always see in
Every room also has a meeting corner with a projector showing slides, a printer and a water dispenser
People move: some get up now and then to walk to the water dispenser or the printer and back
At lunch, 12 to 1, everyone who is in sits in the canteen
Every Friday from 4 to 5 PM, everyone gathers in the all-hands room — 30 chairs, a stage and the projector — with one person presenting
Doors on every room, a main entrance, a fire exit with a lit EXIT sign, and fire extinguishers
A lobby inside the entrance: carpets, a security desk with a guard and a wall of CCTV feeds, turnstiles, visitor seating, and CCTV cameras round the office
Timed in and not timed out means at the desk — including somebody who forgot to time out, so the office shows what the DTR says
Still timed in after 10 hours turns their marker amber, which is usually a forgotten time-out
Gone home, on leave and not in leave an empty desk; hover any desk for who and since when
Team leaders and above can click any desk to open that person's DTR; everyone else can open their own
Each room's sign counts who is in, and the office refreshes every minute
The all-hands screen shows this week's Weekly Team Collaboration slide
pending: Needs its database function: paste supabase/migrations/20261031090000_p17_07_office_presence.sql into the Supabase SQL editor. Until then, team leaders see only their own departments and everyone else sees only themselves.
